1: There is hereby created a Commission to be known and designated as the City of McIntyre Tree Commission and to be herein referred to as the “Commission” for the purpose of regulating the planting, maintenance and removal of trees and shrubs in public places; providing for the pruning and removal of trees on private property which endanger public safety and to generally improve the general welfare and health of the people of the City of McIntyre and Wilkinson County.
4:
OFFICERS AND MEETINGS: Upon appointment of the initial Commission by Mayor and Council, said Commission shall meet and elect one of its members as Chairman and one of its members as Secretary. The Commission shall then provide for the rules and procedures for the holding of regular and special meetings of the Commission as deemed advisable and necessary.

SO ORDAINED, this day of

Mayor, City of Mcintyre

ATTEST s

Clerk of Council, City of McIntyre

It is hereby declared to be the intention of he Mayor and Council that the following proposed change be made to the ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING THE CITY OF MCINTYRE TREE COMMISSION:
6:
The Commission shall consist of the McIntyre Street

Manager, appointed by the Mayor of McIntyre, and the McIntyre Street Superintendent with the help of other employees of the City.
